name: recipe_image_failed
description: Recipe pictures not delivered for a reason about the provider (image_call lines with outcome CONFIG or INFRA, after any retry and fallback), by outcome and provider. Source of the alert "Recipe: recipe pictures failing broadly" (functions/README.md, "Alerts").
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND jsonPayload.message="image_call" AND jsonPayload.outcome=("CONFIG" OR "INFRA")

labels.description: The picture provider in force (vertex, openai, ...)
